title: Kids turned low-traffic NPR Spotify comments into a secret group chat
why_read: A fun social/cultural anecdote about creative use of Spotify comments, but it's light on technical substance.
analysis: This is a human-interest story about kids exploiting an obscure, low-traffic comment section as an improvised messaging platform rather than a deep technical piece. It touches on emergent behavior and platform design gaps but doesn't offer engineering depth. Still mildly interesting as a case study in how features get repurposed in unintended ways.
